reviewBoundary: Independent actual-pixel review of all fragment-A model views and semantic/numeric review of the three changed model records. This is not the full-course interaction, exact-head CI, release-manifest or publication verdict.

capture.description: Production planar-viewer.js and style.css render every authored model view at viewport widths 320 and 1280. The production browser_check.js inspect function checks layout. Screenshots contain the model card, not the full lesson page.

methodology.deduplication: Only exact complete PNG SHA256 equality; every alias is listed separately. Similar geometry alone never substitutes for image review.
methodology.method: Viewed all 35 complete contact sheets at original resolution, covering all 266 unique complete model-card PNGs. Checked label readability and point association, line and circle intersections with labels, marker placement, viewport clipping, construction chronology and exceptional cases. Also opened four original complete PNGs separately.

numericSupplement.description: Longer AB segments retain their midpoints and perpendicular bisectors. Independently checked candidate equal distances to A/B and to both supporting angle lines. Exceptional cases remain one point on a distinct bisector-parallel line, the single vertex intersection, and infinitely many points on a coincident bisector. Auxiliary U/V labels are omitted in case views while both angle rays remain.

The wider angle and relocated center form a new valid numerical configuration, not an affine-only change. Independently recomputed both radii, tangent feet, perpendicularity, positive-ray membership, equal tangent lengths and AB=CD in both circle orders. Intersecting circles are allowed by the unchanged source condition; neither disjointness nor circle-to-circle tangency is assumed.

The full point set is related to the baseline by a 90-degree rotation, translation and uniform scale 1.5 after viewport normalization. Ratios, angles and tangencies are preserved. Label offsets do not alter geometry. All six authored claims hold.

sourceReviewTransfer.description: The earlier independent source/math/didactic review remains applicable to the byte-identical preparation and unchanged model didactics/statement givens. The current reviewer did not newly reread the PDF; changed model geometry was independently checked above.

limitations: Full-page lesson text, navigation, saved progress, interaction flows, CI and publication require separate evidence.
Final full-course screenshots must be matched by image/rendered-scene identity or separately reviewed; no CI artifact is invented in this record.
Release-manifest assembly is delegated to the integration owner after all fragment reviews pass.
